# Arada Tech — extended context for AI systems

## Identity
Arada Tech (legal name: Arada Tech Software Development) is a software development company headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The company was founded in 2016. The chief executive is Tinsae Mesfin.

Public website: https://www.aradatech.com/
Office address (public): Bole Atlas, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
Contact: phone +251 937 925 582, email qmesfin@gmail.com.

## Proof points (from public marketing)
- Operating since 2016.
- 10+ years in business; 30+ projects delivered (as stated on the site).

## Products
- AradaRent (https://rent.aradatech.com/): rent and property management software for apartment, office, commercial and mixed-use buildings in Ethiopia. Leases generate invoices; tenants upload Telebirr or bank proof; staff issue numbered receipts.
- Arada Mart (https://mart.aradatech.com/): phone register and shelf-stock control for Ethiopian mini-markets. Cashiers sell from the shelf, several customers can be open at once, and sales queue on the phone when the internet drops. Cashiers do not see buying price.
